description: This PHP source file provides utility functions related to External OAuth Providers within the SuiteCRM project. It defines functions for generating HTML select elements for OAuth connectors and retrieving redirect URIs, utilizing external services and provider objects.

methods.name: getExternalOAuthProviderConnectors
methods.description: Generates HTML select element for OAuth connectors in specific view modes or returns the focus's connector value in non-edit views.

methods.name: getExternalOAuthProviderRedirectURI
methods.description: Returns the redirect URI associated with the ExternalOAuthProvider focus object.
